channel.title: Slope Shirts
channel.description: Custom ski town apparel printed in-house

item.g:title: Custom Ski Town T-Shirt | Slope Shirts
item.g:description: The Forever Tee is our softest everyday shirt: a lightweight tri-blend with a broken-in feel that layers perfectly under a ski jacket and works for every day after the trip. Printed in-house on a Next Level 6010. Pick any ski town from our list or type your own, choose a design and ink color, and we print it in-house. Specs: 4.2 oz tri-blend; 50% polyester / 25% combed ring-spun cotton / 25% rayon; Regular unisex fit.

item.g:title: Custom Ski Town Crewneck Sweatshirt | Slope Shirts
item.g:description: The Comfort Crewneck is the classic ski-town sweatshirt: heavyweight, garment-dyed fleece with a soft, lived-in feel, made for cold mornings, the drive up and every day after. Printed in-house on a Comfort Colors 1566. Pick any ski town from our list or type your own, choose a design and ink color, and we print it in-house. Specs: 9.5 oz heavyweight fleece; 80% ring-spun cotton / 20% polyester, 100% cotton face; Garment dyed for a lived-in feel; Relaxed fit.

item.g:title: Custom Ski Town Quarter-Zip Sweatshirt | Slope Shirts
item.g:description: The Lodge Quarter-Zip is the classic ski-lodge pullover: heavyweight, garment-dyed fleece with a quarter zip and a soft, lived-in feel. Printed in-house on a Comfort Colors 1580. Pick any ski town from our list or type your own, choose a design and ink color, and we print it in-house. Specs: 9.5 oz heavyweight fleece; 80% ring-spun cotton / 20% polyester, 100% cotton face; Garment dyed; Quarter zip with self-fabric lined collar; Relaxed fit.

item.g:title: Custom Ski Town Hoodie | Slope Shirts
item.g:description: The Forever Hoodie is soft everyday comfort with a warm midweight feel, perfect for cold mountain nights, après and everyday wear. Printed in-house on a Next Level 9302. Pick any ski town from our list or type your own, choose a design and ink color, and we print it in-house. Specs: 7.4 oz fleece; 60% cotton / 40% polyester; Jersey-lined hood; Unisex fit.

item.g:title: Custom Ski Town Lightweight Hooded Long Sleeve Tee | Slope Shirts
item.g:description: The Everyday Light Hoodie is a soft, lightweight jersey hooded long sleeve tee: an easy layer for the lodge, the drive home and everyday comfort. Printed in-house on a BELLA+CANVAS 3512. Pick any ski town from our list or type your own, choose a design and ink color, and we print it in-house. Specs: 4.2 oz lightweight jersey; White: 100% Airlume cotton; heathers: 52/48 cotton/polyester; triblends: 50/25/25 polyester/cotton/rayon; Crossover V at neckline; Unisex sizing, runs small: consider sizing up.

item.g:title: Custom Ski Town Women's Crop Hoodie | Slope Shirts
item.g:description: The Women's Crop Hoodie is a soft, cropped fleece layer with a raw hem and dropped shoulders, made for après, cozy nights and everyday comfort. Printed in-house on a BELLA+CANVAS 7502. Pick any ski town from our list or type your own, choose a design and ink color, and we print it in-house. Specs: 8 oz fleece; 52% Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton / 48% polyester; Raw hem, dropped shoulders; Dyed-to-match drawcord.

item.g:title: Custom Ski Town Full-Zip Hoodie | Slope Shirts
item.g:description: The Zip Up is a soft full-zip layer for cold mornings, chairlift rides and village strolls. The design prints on the back. Printed in-house on a BELLA+CANVAS 3739. Pick any ski town from our list or type your own, choose a design and ink color, and we print it in-house. Specs: 8 oz fleece; 52% Airlume combed and ring-spun cotton / 48% polyester (Athletic Heather 90/10); White drawcord and zipper tape, metal zipper; Unisex sizing.

item.g:title: Custom Ski Town Kids' Hoodie | Slope Shirts
item.g:description: The Kids' Hoodie is a warm, classic-fit youth hoodie, so the whole family can match on ski week. Printed in-house on a Gildan 18500B. Pick any ski town from our list or type your own, choose a design and ink color, and we print it in-house. Specs: 8 oz fleece; 50% cotton / 50% polyester; Double-lined hood, pouch pocket; Youth sizes.

item.g:title: Custom Ski Town Fleece Blanket | Slope Shirts
item.g:description: The Lodge Blanket is a soft 50" x 60" sweatshirt-fleece blanket for the lodge, the couch or anywhere you want to bring your happy place with you. Printed in-house on a Independent Trading Co. INDBKTSB. Pick any ski town from our list or type your own, choose a design and ink color, and we print it in-house. Specs: 8 oz fleece; 52% ring-spun cotton / 48% polyester; Double-needle hemmed edges; Ships folded with a drawcord tie; 50" x 60".

item.g:title: Custom Ski Town Flannel Pajama Pants | Slope Shirts
item.g:description: The Pajama Pants are made for cozy ski-lodge comfort with a soft double-brushed flannel feel, perfect for lazy mornings and cold nights. Printed in-house on a Boxercraft BM6624. Pick any ski town from our list or type your own, choose a design and ink color, and we print it in-house. Specs: 4.3 oz flannel; 100% double-brushed cotton flannel; Elastic waistband with inner drawcord; Side seam pockets.
